ETH.note: The NBE official speaks on regulation in general; no payments mandate, licensing or switch role stated.
Data protection and cybersecurity are called for, but no rule for digital financial services is stated.
No government payment to people stated.

facts.fact: The National Bank of Ethiopia's regulation director said mobile banking, mobile money and digital payments are growing, with digital financial transactions worth 33 trillion birr in fiscal 2025/26.

ETH.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
